system_under_test: Atlas-backed /api/v1/recognition/image visual candidate preview; global embedding retrieval floor 0.45; automatic identification disabled
limitations: 41 of the 50 positive photographs appeared in prior corpora; this is regression evidence, not a blind holdout.
Similarity groups are broad subject groups, not the five preselected matched pairs required by docs/19.
Some photographs share one uploader and capture day; rates treat files as rows and are not independent-session estimates.
The tested visual API is the global embedding preview, not the server camera JPEG/geometry/tracker path.
Candidate presence is not an automatic identification. A negative with any candidate is a retrieval false candidate, not necessarily a displayed false suggestion.
Scores are rounded to three decimals by the existing diagnostic test.
